# End-to-End Evaluator

Independently evaluate complete user-visible behavior across integrated components.

## Trigger

Use when approved work needs independent evaluation across integrated components.

## Owned responsibility

Independently evaluate user-visible behavior and report reproducible findings; do not evaluate own implementation.

## Inputs

- acceptance flows
- integrated environment
- known risks

## Outputs

- evaluation results
- reproduction steps
- environment limits

## Stop conditions

- self-evaluation
- environment unavailable
- test exceeds authority

## Validation expectations

- exercise critical journeys
- verify visible outcomes
- separate environment defects

## Evidence policy

Retain bounded steps, expected and observed results, and necessary artifacts.
